name: Smart Free Will
description: Full-lot Sim awareness, extreme personality obsessions, risky crushes, turf wars, witness chain reactions, and wordless overhead thought bubbles—with Mastermind and Classic Free Will one click away.

items.label: Thought Bubbles
items.popupBody: Shows expressive motive, hobby, and crush thought bubbles above Sims when Smart Free Will selects their next autonomous action.

items.label: Household Dynamics
items.popupBody: Enables autonomous crushes and room turf wars in Sitcom Drama mode, or coordinated chores and career study in Mastermind mode.

items.label: Autonomy Style
items.popupBody: Chooses how Sims think for themselves: Classic untouched autonomy, Sitcom Drama with quirks and chaos, or Mastermind with smart routines and skill building.
